text: Tanvi has her second interview at the council on Thursday 6th Nov, panel of three. She's properly nervous. Text her good luck Wednesday night
Femi's dad back in hospital since Sunday, chest infection again. Femi's driving up to Leicester tomorrow to be with him
kiri half marathon sun 9th. aiming sub 2hrs. knee been playing up
Vera said Andre didn't get the Arup job. Gutted, he'd got down to the last two. Applying to Mott MacDonald next
Dafydd's choir concert is 14 November at St Mary's, 7.30. I'm going with Fern, already got tickets.
Need to ring Suzanne Friday and see how her mum's hip op went
Caitlin - new job at the hospice starts 3rd of Dec. Leaving drinks at the Crown next Friday

So Keisha was telling me her little one, Kiri, has had tonsillitis twice this month and they've finally got a referral to ENT on the 27/10. She's exhausted, hasn't slept properly in a week, and her husband's away with work until the weekend. I should drop round some food on Tuesday and offer to do a school run.
Mihai plays bass in a covers band called The Late Shift. Gig at the Fleece on Saturday

Ask Chen how the assessment centre went. It was yesterday I think. Group exercise in the morning, then a presentation, then a one to one with the hiring manager. He was worried about the presentation because he hates public speaking, and his boss at the current place doesn't know he's looking. Should hear by Friday

shanice broke her wrist at netball tues night, landed badly going for an interception. cast for 6 weeks, can't drive, can't work either cos she's a nurse. her sister Joy is ferrying her about. fracture clinic again on 4/11. she's fed up and bored stiff already. maybe take her some puzzle books and a curry on the weekend
Zeynep's audition for the conservatory is the 12th of December. Cello. Practising four hours a day apparently
dentist moved to tues 4th, 9am. take the car in after
Siddharth and Anjali both running the Brighton 10k this weekend, first race together since the wedding
Mila's interview at Deloitte got cancelled, they've frozen hiring. She's applying to KPMG instead and hears back in a fortnight
Don't forget Henrik's birthday is the 2nd of Nov. He's been eyeing up a new pair of football boots, Predators
Emil's mum had a fall last week, bruised ribs but nothing broken. He's flying to Copenhagen on Monday for ten days to look after her. Must message him while he's out there
Valentina is vegetarian now, been about two months
Irina - got the job!! Head of design at the agency, starts in January. Send congrats + flowers
Kasia's lad Henrik has his grade 5 piano exam on 18/11. She's more nervous than he is lol
school play is next thurs, Rebecca is a shepherd. Chris can't make it, he's got a hospital appointment that afternoon
Svetlana says the long Covid is getting worse, she's cut down to three days at work. Feeling pretty low about it. I need to check in on her next week
Aurelio Moreau, Ray to everyone, coaches the under 12s at the rugby club. Final of the county cup is 22nd Nov
Chat with Dorota after yoga. She's been off sick with migraines most of October. Got a neurology appointment on the 5th of November
Anika applying for the PhD at Edinburgh, deadline is 1 December. Wants me to read her personal statement before then. Remind me to do that this weekend.

Voice note: Okay so Fern rang, her brother Femi has his job interview with the fire service tomorrow morning, the fitness test part is Friday, and then if he passes that there's a final interview on the 30th. He's absolutely bricking it about the bleep test. Fern says text him good luck tonight, he'd appreciate it.
Kwame's dog Biscuit got hit by a bike, has a fractured leg. Vet op was Saturday, seems ok
Femi's band are playing Glastonbury next year!! Huge for them. He's over the moon

Andre rang this morning, sounding giddy. His partner Joy had the 12 week scan on Monday and everything looks fine, due date is 3rd April. They're telling her parents this weekend over Sunday lunch. Joy's had awful morning sickness though, signed off work for a week. Get them a little something, maybe a babygrow, and drop it round next week
Need to pick up prescription, post Nan's card, renew railcard before Friday
Tanvi didn't get the council job in the end. They went internal. She's disappointed but already has another one lined up for next Weds. Call her at the weekend
Keisha mentioned she loves anything by Sally Rooney and she's into wild swimming now
ok so Chris and Rebecca are doing the Three Peaks charity thing the weekend of 14/15 June next year. Training most Sundays. I said I'd sponsor them.
caitlin's dad diagnosed w/ type 2 diabetes. she's worried, trying to get him to cut sugar
Mila mentioned her sister Valentina passed her driving test this morning! Fourth go
Dorota's son Mihai starts uni in Manchester in September, studying physics
Siddharth's off work with a slipped disc, physio on Wednesday and Friday. In loads of pain. Must pop round with some magazines
Picked up the tickets for Hamilton, 8th of March, matinee
Shanice works at the Royal Free, neonatal nurse. Lives in Kentish Town with her girlfriend
Aurelio's daughter has chicken pox so the match on Sunday is off for him. Rescheduled to 30 Nov
Valentina's brother Emil is in the boxing final at the York Hall on Saturday 15 Nov. She asked if I want to come. Let her know by Thursday

Henrik said he hates his job and has been quietly applying elsewhere. Had a phone screen with Spotify yesterday, next round is a technical test on the 29th and then a panel the week after if he gets through. His manager's been making life hell since the restructure in the summer, and he says he's barely sleeping. Message him on the 30th to see how the test went
Irina's cat Pushkin went missing Tuesday, found him Thursday in the neighbour's shed. She was in bits

Had a long catch up with Anjali on the phone. Her dad's been diagnosed with early onset Parkinson's, they found out last Wednesday. She's taking a few weeks off work from Monday to help her mum sort things out, and she's struggling with it. Her brother Siddharth's coming over from Toronto on the 8th. Need to send something, maybe a meal delivery, and call her after the weekend.

Kiri finished the half in 1:56!! New PB, and the knee held up. She's already talking about doing the Manchester marathon in April, wants to start a proper plan after Christmas. Her partner Chris ran the last few miles with her which was sweet. Text to congratulate

Zeynep loves Shostakovich and hates being called Zey. Her flatmate Anika plays violin in the same quartet. Zeynep's mum is a GP in Bristol and her dad teaches maths. She's allergic to nuts, carries an epipen, and wants to move to Vienna eventually. Mentioned a nice music stand would make a good birthday present
Kwame's wife Fern had her gallbladder out on Friday. Home now but sore. He's doing all the school runs
don't forget Dafydd's leaving do is tomorrow, 6pm, Brewdog
Kwame's interview with the Met Office is on 10 Nov. He's prepping with his old boss. Seems pretty calm about it actually
Talked to Kasia and Chen at the barbecue. Kasia's training for a triathlon in May and Chen just started a new job at Ocado as a data analyst
Suzanne's mum is out of hospital, recovering at Suzanne's for the next fortnight. Suzanne is knackered
Vera's grandson Dafydd is playing Joseph in the nativity, 11th December. She's very proud
Fern was saying her daughter's been having panic attacks before school. Seeing a counsellor on Mondays now. Fern's not coping brilliantly either, I should ask her for coffee this week
Andre's mate Kwame organised a five-a-side tournament for Movember, 23rd Nov. I'm doing the bacon rolls.
Emil got back from Copenhagen Sunday. Mum's much better. Should ask him round for dinner soon
Anika's got glandular fever, off uni for at least three weeks
car MOT due 19/11, book it
Rebecca's up for the regional dance competition 7th of March in Birmingham. Practising every night. Her mum says she's a bag of nerves. Send her a good luck card that week
Dr Gupta said results back in ten days. Chase on the 30th if not heard
Svetlana's daughter Tanvi got into the county youth orchestra! Violin. First rehearsal next Saturday
